system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim manifest requesting 50 GiB of fast SSD-backed storage for a database StatefulSet.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim manifest requesting 50 GiB of fast SSD-backed storage for a database StatefulSet.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: database-data
  namespace: database
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: database
    app.kubernetes.io/component: storage
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
  annotations:
    description: "Fast SSD-backed persistent storage for database StatefulSet"
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: fast-ssd
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 50Gi
